text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spring arrived as <chrname> moved up to the Classic 
Class. Excavation efforts at the hot 
spring resort were in full swing... but 
then!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Lately, it feels like customer traffic has 
kind of slowed down...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Guess the viral hype has passed... Though 
it might still be a lot compared to last 
year..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It'd be such a waste if things cooled off 
like this. Just when I was getting all 
fired up.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhh~~♪ Splish splash~~♪ Warm water so 
soft~~♪ Pure para~~dise~~♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Young proprietress~~! Do you have any 
great ideas to get everyone hyped up? 
Information desperately needed...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about the legend of the 
"Rainbow-Colored Hidden Spring", said to 
cure all ailments?
choice_data_list: "The Legend of the Secret Hot Spring"...?!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, according to the legends, there was 
once a legendary rainbow hot spring here 
that worked wonders for Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"Cures any illness or injury on the spot!" 
...Supposedly, it was a magical hot spring 
like that♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
However, according to the rest of the 
legend, the hot spring eventually stopped 
flowing, and its location is now 
unknown...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it really is a shame. If such a 
magical hot spring truly existed, just 
imagine how many Umamusume it could save.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oho. That's pretty cool...! It's got that 
tsuchinoko-like sense of wonder.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"If we find that hot spring... or rather, 
if we uncover the 'truth,' wouldn't that 
be super hot?!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Does the hidden hot spring really exist? 
Are its health benefits real? Why was such 
a legend born? ...That kind of thing!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
That's true! Just how much of this legend 
is actually real...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho...! How do you read this~? Let's 
see, cursive script reader app...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you're still here? I'm about to close 
up shop soon."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, sorry! I haven't taken a bath 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...? What's got her so worked up all of a 
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before bed. When I went to take a quick 
bath, I ran into Transcend at the 
entrance, looking like she had just gotten 
out.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~... Hidden hot spring, hidden hot 
spring... the legendary hidden spring! If 
we find it, it'll be the discovery of the 
century~♪
choice_data_list:
You're totally hooked on the legend of the 
hidden hot spring, huh?

You're totally hooked on the legend of the 
hidden hot spring, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! If it exists, you'd wanna 
take a dip, right? A supreme hot spring 
nobody knows about!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, seriously! If a hot spring like 
that actually existed, guests would come 
flooding in! The inn would totally be 
booming♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend can barely contain her 
excitement. Her eyes are sparkling with 
anticipation...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly recall the time Hokko Tarumae 
told me about how she "pushed herself too 
hard."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, she had to psyche herself up to 
work toward her goals, but who Transcend 
is today is a little different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with a goal in mind, she was driven 
by a curiosity beyond it... itching just 
to do the thing itself...
choice_data_list:
(It's that feeling like I just have to do 
it—)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I found info online too! And I wanna hit 
the library first thing tomorrow morning! 
Aaargh, I don't have enough eyes for this!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Leave it to meee!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
The light is still on in Lady Tran's 
room... I'm worried about her sleep 
schedule. Perhaps I should bring some 
refreshments and check on her—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Nah, just leave it in front of the sliding 
door. "Those kinds of folks" are fine like 
that. Let 'em do whatever until they're 
satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I should ask for info on the 
bulletin board too... I think one of my 
gaming friends did research on earth 
science, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Bulletin Board
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't water use to flow around here?" 
"Tell me how far it is from the other hot 
spring sources~" "I live in the next town 
over, and I've heard a similar rumor."

text_block_list.name: Bulletin Board
text_block_list.text:
"Hello. That detector is a splendid 
invention. However, I have a proposal to 
further improve its accuracy. May we 
converse using the translator?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! Ooooh...! Here it comes, the 
collective wisdom of the world!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
—So, 'Detector Improvements'? You put this 
whole document together overnight?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Looks like the Landlady's hot spring 
detector still has room for an update!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, I've been doing some thinking... 
Landlady, what do you think of this!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, certainly, with this we might just 
discover a hot spring source at depths 
that never caught our instruments before.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do it! As the developer, 
I'll handle the tinkering. You give me a 
hand!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright! That's the spirit! I'll go get 
ready right away!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... Transcend and the proprietress 
upgraded the hot spring detector!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's done! With this, even the secret 
hot spring...! Time to test it—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(No, wait. Isn't it a waste to keep such 
an interesting gadget just between 
ourselves...?)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(There are voices on the message boards 
saying "I wanna see it" too, y'know...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Should I invite them? As a thank-you...! 
I mean, tourists would love this too. 
Yeah, let's make it a huge event...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ……Aaargh!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I don't have time to soak in hereee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And a few days later, a surprise project 
was launched at the Yukoma Inn! What was 
this project that brought so many 
together...?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then everyone, please board the bus~! 
Departing for the 'New Hot Spring Detector 
Test Meeting'~~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! I hope we find a nice hot spring♪ 
Ehehe, I can't wait to be refreshed 
again~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the new hot spring 
too. Leave the digging to me! Look at all 
these guests... Expectations are high, 
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Crazy, right? I was wide awake all night 
too! One thing led to another and I pulled 
a total all-nighter."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, I just can't sit still! Maybe it's 
because I've been resting properly lately, 
but I've got so much leftover energy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arrived at a corner of the mountain 
behind the academy. With everyone watching 
with bated breath, the detector was 
switched on...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
With the detector's previous precision, 
there wasn't supposed to be anything here, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it's waaay, waaay down deep 
underground! Or so this new detector of 
mine says.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: O-Ohhh... That's close!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Right heeeeere!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Alrighty, let's have the excavation 
kickoff led by our eager volunteer right 
here! Let's get a quick interview on how 
you're feelin' right now~"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Digging for hot springs is something 
I could rarely ever do even back home in 
the mountains, so I'm really excited.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The excavator's all set up, so right now 
we're just waiting for the right moment.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're all ready too! Here we 
go then—ready, set!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Heeeeeave-hooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The giant human-powered excavator springs 
into action! The sheer spectacle left the 
tourists gasping in awe!"

text_block_list.name: Tourists
text_block_list.text:
Oho, amazing! It moved! Keep it up! 
Everyoneeee!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhhーーーーっ!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack... bubbling...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: It came outttt!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: …………There it is.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Bingo~~!! Landladyyy~!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: There it is...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
This scent... what a unique spring 
quality. An iron-rich reddish spring, is 
it? Let's check the pH. Oho, wouldn't this 
be great for drinking, too!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Landlady! Could this possibly 
be...! The legendary hidden hot spring!?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
A legendary hidden hot spring? Whoa, hold 
on... Did you upgrade the detector just 
for that?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! As if! That's obviously not it!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
The water quality isn't bad, but it might 
be a bit too lukewarm to pipe all the way 
to the hot spring town.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, guess we won't find it that easily, 
huh? Still, this detector's working like a 
charm, isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! At this rate, if we do some serious 
digging in other spots too, we're bound to 
find an even better hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "New Hot Springs Detector 
Trial Run" was a huge success! The event 
generated massive buzz...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, my, my~! The interview requests just 
keep flooding in.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Accept every last one! It's an opportunity 
those kids created for us. Why not take 
advantage and promote ourselves?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Looks like things are about to get busy 
again. Good grief, talk about a happy 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Still, a 'legendary secret hot spring', 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when I went looking for 
that sort of thing too, wasn't there...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—*Yaaawn*...! ...Uh, after the event... 
and it's already 5:00 AM...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Man, I slept like a log...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaahhh~~~... A hot spring after a deep 
sleep really hits the spot...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, Tran-san. Morning. Did you sleep 
well?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, talk about déjà vu. Someone told me 
the exact same thing back in the day. When 
I was passed out asleep in my dorm room 
all day...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Unlike back then, I feel super 
refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaargh... Been ages since I went all out 
like that~~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You've been running around non-stop 
lately, after all. Doing your training 
properly without slacking off.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, before I knew it, I was just running 
full speed ahead, you know? I just really 
wanted to do it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ Good job, good job. After giving 
it your all, you've got to rest with all 
your might too, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm not doing anything today or 
tomorrow. Aahh~~, so tasty♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
You do that, you do that. And... no, 
that's just fine.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Up until yesterday, you were what folks 
call 'in the zone.'

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
In other words, extreme focus... right? A 
state where you could give 120% right when 
it mattered most.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
That kind of power simply can't come from 
a body plagued by chronic fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"If you conserve your strength on a 
regular basis, you can unleash it when it 
truly counts. You've gotta run your races 
like that too!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see. Yeah, if you're low on HP and MP, 
'Run' is your only choice even if a rare 
monster shows up.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You never know when that 'moment' is gonna 
come♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Alrighty~ Now that we've discovered yet 
another point to taking a break~"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Time to catch another nap on the latest 
massage chair. Zzz...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the Hot Spring Detector was 
powered up. The day they find the 
legendary hidden spring might be closer 
than they think...!
